tasks.short: Evaluate and revise chemistry curricula and instructional materials

steps.what: Evaluate actual chemistry assessment findings, student feedback and existing course/laboratory materials
inputs: actual course materials and laboratory exercises
existing assessment findings and student feedback

steps.what: Plan the learning progression, content changes and instructional methods for the actual chemistry course
inputs: teacher's evaluated chemistry-learning gaps
actual programme outcomes and laboratory constraints
outputs: teacher's curriculum and instructional revision decisions

steps.what: Revise and check the actual chemistry content, laboratory instructions and course materials against the selected learning goals
inputs: teacher's curriculum and instructional revision decisions
actual existing chemistry diagrams, equations and material components

steps.what: Save the completed checked chemistry material revision in the course workspace
inputs: complete checked chemistry course-material revision

tasks.design: Configure reusable existing material components and equation/figure styles in {DOCS} and {LMS}. The teacher evaluates learning needs and revises the actual content and laboratory instructions; only repeated component placement and formatting change before the checked revision is saved.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated formatting of equations, figures and existing course components can accompany substantive revision.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable blocks and document styles can reuse actual existing content.
tasks.still_hard: Chemical correctness, laboratory feasibility and appropriate learning progression require teacher judgment.
tasks.human_edge: Choose explanations and experiments that address actual student misconceptions.

ambition.what: No extra course or laboratory capacity assumed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native reusable document components and equation/figure styles can reduce formatting while chemistry content and laboratory instruction remain teacher-controlled.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. The only saving is repeated layout/component handling already present in actual revision work.
The teacher's existing materials supply the figures/equations; s1/s2 produce the actual revision decisions. Missing content is written by the teacher, not inferred.
No automatic experiment design or chemistry reasoning is proposed. Existing equivalent reusable blocks remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 5.9 minus 1 hour of component/style upkeep gives 4.9 net. Same-system save is negligible and fully retained.
unknowns: Existing component reuse and formatting effort
research_questions: Which actual chemistry material revisions still repeat equation/figure formatting that native components can remove?

already_counted.description: Revise and check the substantive chemistry materials and laboratory instructions

incremental.description: Maintain reusable component links and equation/figure styles

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 4.9%; substantive curriculum and laboratory decisions remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open the student's actual problem, submitted work or relevant course instruction when needed during office hours
inputs: student's actual question and submitted work
existing course problem and instructions
outputs: teacher-read material relevant to the student's question

steps.what: Remain available at scheduled office hours and work through the student's actual chemistry questions and difficulties
inputs: teacher-read material relevant to the student's question
student's actual reasoning and responses
outputs: actual individual chemistry explanation and assistance

tasks.design: Retain scheduled availability and individual chemistry assistance with the teacher. Actual course-material lookup is separate and already uses {LMS}; no additional retrieval change is established here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Office hours depend on the actual student's difficulty and live explanation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing course links support the occasional lookup; no new mechanism is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: A correct final answer does not reveal why the student is confused.
tasks.human_edge: Follow the student's reasoning and choose a useful next explanation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: office hours require scheduled availability and responsive explanation, with existing course links supporting actual problem lookup.

assumptions: The 5/95 split is an unmeasured scenario, with no term-level preparation baseline added to each office hour.
The student supplies the actual question/work; no structured misconception profile or automatic diagnosis is assumed.
Actual lookup is split and unchanged. No separate written report, send or save is established by this statement.
Gross/net saving are zero and no new upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Actual lookup friction and written follow-up frequency
research_questions: Do observed office hours reveal a repeated lookup or actual written follow-up that warrants its own design?

incremental.description: No new system or process proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Live assistance, availability and existing course lookup remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct chemistry research and publish the findings

steps.what: Read actual relevant chemistry literature and earlier research records
inputs: actual research question
existing scientific-source and prior research records
outputs: teacher-read research background and evidence gaps

steps.what: Design the actual research methods, experiments and analysis approach
inputs: teacher-read research background and evidence gaps
actual scientific question and available laboratory resources
outputs: teacher's research design and analysis method

steps.what: Conduct the actual experiments and capture the real observations, conditions and instrument outputs
inputs: teacher's research design and analysis method
actual laboratory samples, equipment and materials
outputs: actual sample-linked experimental records and instrument data

steps.what: Process the actual instrument data with the chosen method and interpret the results, controls and uncertainty
inputs: actual sample-linked experimental records and instrument data
teacher's research design and analysis method

steps.what: Write and check the manuscript, figures, references and exact first-submission package
inputs: teacher-checked chemistry results and interpretation
actual experimental records and selected literature
actual journal submission instructions
outputs: complete checked first manuscript package and journal destination

steps.what: Submit the exact checked first manuscript package to the selected journal
inputs: complete checked first manuscript package and journal destination

steps.what: Evaluate the actual editorial/reviewer feedback and complete and check the revised manuscript and response for publication
inputs: submitted first manuscript package
journal's actual editorial and reviewer feedback
actual supporting research records
outputs: complete checked revised manuscript and response package with destination

steps.what: Resubmit the exact checked revised manuscript and response package to the journal
inputs: complete checked revised manuscript and response package with destination

tasks.design: Configure native source views and repeatable analysis profiles in {OTHER}, the scientific-library and instrument-analysis applications, plus actual figure/reference links in {DOCS}. The teacher designs and conducts the research, interprets results and checks each publication package; first submission and revised submission are separate gated actions in {PARTNER_PORTAL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source navigation, human analysis setup and figure/reference formatting can accompany research.
tasks.enabler_now: Native analysis profiles and source-linked document fields can reuse actual records.
tasks.still_hard: Experimental validity, interpretation, novelty and peer-review responses require scientific judgment.
tasks.human_edge: Determine what the actual evidence supports and defend the research's contribution.

ambition.what: No extra findings or publication acceptance claimed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for research-data, source-licence and instrument access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native research-source views, analysis profiles and figure/reference links can reduce repeated handling while experimental work and scientific interpretation remain human.

assumptions: Shares are an unmeasured research-to-publication scenario with one revision round. Instrument runtime, journal review and publisher production are not focal-role labour or claimed savings.

OTHER means scientific libraries, laboratory capture and instrument-analysis applications. The teacher creates actual sample-linked data/conditions in s3 and selects methods in s2; missing sample metadata or invalid controls require manual investigation.
Only repeated human navigation/setup/formatting changes; no model invents results or interprets chemistry. Existing equivalent profiles and linked figures remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 3.9 minus 1 hour of analysis-profile and document-link upkeep gives 2.9 net. All submission actions remain fully retained.

This ownership scenario has the teacher as sole authorised corresponding author; where coauthors must approve the exact package, their approval and labour must be added before any send rather than assumed free.
The journal produces actual review feedback after s6. Any revised package uses the new s7 check and cannot reuse the initial approval; publication acceptance remains the editor's decision.
unknowns: Current analysis automation, authorship approvals and publication lifecycle
research_questions: Which real repeated analysis setup and figure/reference handling remains beyond the existing native tools?

already_counted.description: Inspect sources, interpret processed results and write/check the first manuscript

incremental.description: Maintain and validate analysis profiles and actual figure/reference links

approvals.approved_version: complete checked first manuscript package and journal destination
complete checked revised manuscript and response package with destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 2.9%; actual research and scientific/publication decisions remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Initiate and moderate chemistry classroom discussions

steps.what: Introduce the actual chemistry question, observation or problem and invite students to explain their reasoning
inputs: actual lesson topic or problem
students present in the class
outputs: actual discussion question and initial student contributions

steps.what: Facilitate and moderate the actual classroom exchange, probe chemical reasoning and address misconceptions and participation
inputs: actual discussion question and initial student contributions
students' subsequent reasoning and responses
outputs: actual moderated chemistry discussion and explanations

tasks.design: Retain initiation and moderation of the actual classroom discussion with the teacher. The design introduces no automated discussion summary, participation score or substitute conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The next useful question depends on what students actually say.
tasks.enabler_now: No new software mechanism is established that removes the teacher's live discussion work.
tasks.still_hard: Students can use correct vocabulary while holding an incorrect chemical model.
tasks.human_edge: Probe reasoning and bring quieter students into a useful discussion.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: responsive classroom moderation depends on actual student contributions and teacher judgment.

assumptions: Shares are illustrative, not measured. The existing lesson question is an input, not an invented preparation or reporting baseline.
The statement establishes live discussion and no separate record write, report or send; none is added. Actual material revision is represented separately in task 5875.
No transcript, structured participation data or automatic misconception labels are assumed.
All work remains; gross/net saving are zero and no incremental upkeep is required.
unknowns: Actual class format and discussion needs
research_questions: Do observed classes reveal a distinct written follow-up task that should be designed separately?

incremental.description: No new system or discussion process proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No supported change to live initiation, facilitation or moderation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated material and research-data handling while retaining laboratory work, scientific judgment and responsive chemistry teaching.
